name: canonical-beacon
description: Check canonical tags and hreflang clusters in your built static site: missing, multiple, relative or in-body canonicals, targets that are missing, noindex or chained, and hreflang codes, self-references, return links and x-default. Text/JSON/SARIF/Markdown, allowlist with expiry, GitHub Action. Zero deps.
